B uses passive review in places ('review notes', 'skim notes'), revisits law less often early on, and implies an exam format with its 60- and 90-question practice tests. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B brings back all three covered units every weekday, including law, while the new units are taught, and it builds closed-notes recall into the method.
